moments.title: Premier League weekend drama
moments.blurb: The Premier League delivered goals and late drama on Sunday, August 23, with Brighton securing a big win and Liverpool snatching a late draw against Newcastle.

angles.name: Sunday's scores recap
angles.copy: Did you keep up with the Premier League action yesterday? Brighton hammered Aston Villa, Man City clinched a late win, and Liverpool salvaged a point at Newcastle!

angles.name: Liverpool's late comeback
angles.copy: Newcastle thought they had it! Liverpool's Szoboszlai scored a 99th-minute penalty to force a 2-2 draw at St James' Park. What a finish!

moments.title: Monday Night Football: Fulham v Chelsea
moments.blurb: The Premier League action continues tonight, Monday, August 24, with Fulham hosting Chelsea in a London derby.

angles.name: Tonight's fixture kick-off
angles.copy: Monday Night Football is here! Fulham take on Chelsea tonight. Who's taking the points in this London derby? Kick-off 8 PM!

angles.name: Derby day buzz
angles.copy: London derby day! Fulham vs Chelsea always brings the heat. Get ready for tonight's Premier League clash.

moments.title: US Open Tennis begins
moments.blurb: The US Open Tennis Championships officially begin today, August 24, with qualifying rounds and Fan Week activities, leading up to the main draw on August 30.

angles.name: Grand Slam action
angles.copy: The final Grand Slam of the year is underway! The US Open kicks off today with qualifying rounds. Who are you backing for the title?

angles.name: Countdown to main draw
angles.copy: It's officially US Open week! While qualifying heats up today, the main draw action starts this Sunday, August 30th. Get ready for two weeks of epic tennis.

moments.title: All Points East second weekend
moments.blurb: London's All Points East festival continues this week with its second weekend of headline shows from August 28-30, featuring acts like Tyler, The Creator and Twenty One Pilots.

angles.name: East London Festival vibes
angles.copy: All Points East is back for its second weekend! Victoria Park is set for huge shows from Tyler, The Creator (Fri/Sat) and Twenty One Pilots (Sun). Who's going?

angles.name: Weekend lineup highlights
angles.copy: This weekend at All Points East: Tyler, The Creator on Friday & Saturday, followed by Twenty One Pilots closing out the festival on Sunday. Massive acts for East London!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival returns
moments.blurb: The iconic Reading & Leeds Festivals take over the August Bank Holiday weekend, running from August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, and Florence + The Machine.

angles.name: Bank Holiday festival fun
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds is almost here! The biggest weekend of the year kicks off on Thursday. Who are you most excited to see?

angles.name: Headliners ready to rock
angles.copy: From Charli XCX to Florence + The Machine, the Reading & Leeds headliners are set to dominate the stages this Bank Holiday weekend. Get ready!

moments.title: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean top the charts
moments.blurb: Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' holds the Number 1 spot on the Official UK Singles Chart for August 20-26, 2026.

angles.name: Chart topper holds strong
angles.copy: Still at Number 1! Sam Fender & Olivia Dean's 'Rein Me In' is holding strong at the top of the Official UK Singles Chart. Are you still streaming it?

angles.name: New music on the chart
angles.copy: Beyond the top spot, the UK Singles Chart is buzzing with 'Dai Dai' by Shakira & Burna Boy and Ella Langley's 'Choosin' Texas' making waves. What's your favourite new entry?

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing returns soon
moments.blurb: Strictly Come Dancing is set to return in September 2026 with a revamped line-up of hosts (Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, Johannes Radebe) and a new live pairing reveal.

angles.name: Strictly's new era
angles.copy: It's almost time! Strictly Come Dancing returns next month with Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe taking the reins. Plus, a live partner reveal!

angles.name: New hosts, new format
angles.copy: Get ready for a Strictly shake-up! New hosts and a surprise live pairing reveal are coming next month. Who's excited for the 2026 series?

moments.title: Bake Off returns with Nigella Lawson
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off is back on Channel 4 in September 2026, with Nigella Lawson joining Paul Hollywood as a new judge.

angles.name: Nigella in the tent
angles.copy: The tent is open for business! The Great British Bake Off returns next month with a brand new judge: Nigella Lawson! We can't wait to see her critiques alongside Paul Hollywood.

angles.name: Sweet September return
angles.copy: Get your aprons ready! Bake Off is back in September, and with Nigella Lawson in the judging panel, it promises to be a delicious series.

moments.title: Dua Lipa turned 31
moments.blurb: Pop superstar Dua Lipa celebrated her 31st birthday on Saturday, August 22, 2026.

angles.name: Birthday shout-out (past)
angles.copy: A belated birthday shout-out to Dua Lipa, who turned 31 on Saturday! What's your favourite track from the 'Future Nostalgia' queen?

moments.title: Florence Welch turns 40
moments.blurb: Florence Welch, the powerful lead singer of Florence + The Machine, will celebrate her 40th birthday on Friday, August 28, 2026.

angles.name: Happy 40th Florence
angles.copy: Getting ready to wish Florence Welch a very happy 40th birthday this Friday! What's your all-time favourite Florence + The Machine anthem?

angles.name: Iconic voice
angles.copy: The incredible voice of Florence Welch turns 40 on Friday! Celebrate early by cranking up your favourite F+TM track.

moments.title: Shania Twain turns 61
moments.blurb: Country-pop icon Shania Twain, known as the 'Queen of Country Pop', will celebrate her 61st birthday on Friday, August 28, 2026.

angles.name: Queen of Country Pop's birthday
angles.copy: Happy 61st Birthday to the one and only Shania Twain this Friday! What's your favourite hit from the Queen of Country Pop?

angles.name: Still the one!
angles.copy: She's still the one! Shania Twain turns 61 on Friday. Get ready to sing along to her timeless classics all week.

moments.title: Van Morrison turns 81
moments.blurb: Legendary Northern Irish singer-songwriter Van Morrison will celebrate his 81st birthday on Monday, August 31, 2026.

angles.name: Van the Man's 81st
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 81st birthday to the iconic Van Morrison this Monday! What's your favourite 'Brown Eyed Girl' or 'Moondance' moment?

angles.name: Celebrating a legend
angles.copy: An absolute legend turns 81 on Monday! Celebrate Van Morrison's incredible career and timeless music with us.

moments.title: Gloria Estefan turns 69
moments.blurb: Cuban-American pop superstar Gloria Estefan, known for hits with Miami Sound Machine, will celebrate her 69th birthday on Tuesday, September 1, 2026.

angles.name: Conga Queen's birthday
angles.copy: Get on your feet! The incredible Gloria Estefan turns 69 this Tuesday! What's your favourite Miami Sound Machine classic?

angles.name: Rhythm is gonna get you
angles.copy: Happy 69th Birthday to the Queen of Latin Pop, Gloria Estefan, on Tuesday! Her music still makes us want to dance.

moments.title: August Bank Holiday Weekend
moments.blurb: The August Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland falls on Monday, August 31, 2026, marking a long weekend for many.

angles.name: Long weekend plans
angles.copy: Bank Holiday vibes loading! Next Monday, August 31st, is the August Bank Holiday for England, Wales & Northern Ireland. What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Making the most of it
angles.copy: Just one week until the August Bank Holiday! Make the most of that extra day off. Are you travelling, staying local, or hitting a festival like Reading & Leeds?
